clariden_observations.home_model_launch_note: Clariden $HOME/model-launch is not the experiment pin. Launchers must use MODEL_LAUNCH_ROOT pointing at 909026a.
clariden_observations.nvidia_smi_on_login: 4x GH200 120GB visible on ln003; do not run 70B serving on the login node

patches.needed_for_eagle: likely; EAGLE uses the same proposer. Historical draft_model load failed on image_token_index. Prove on the first EAGLE launch rather than assuming the 8B failure transfers.

patches.reason: Apertus1p5ForConditionalGeneration.get_language_model() returns ApertusModel, which is itself EagleModelMixin. Pinned SupportsEagle3 dereferences parent_ref.model and AttributeErrors before aux layers can be set.

compatibility_risks: Pinned serving image is vLLM 0.23.1rc1 on ARM64 GH200; TorchSpec's vLLM extra is a generic lower bound, not this Apertus fork.
mooncake-transfer-engine is required by TorchSpec's default pyproject. Offline replay is the one-node fallback if RDMA transport cannot be built on GH200.
TargetLMHead uses text_config.vocab_size (266752) and default key model.norm.weight. Apertus 1.5 lm_head is [131072, 8192] at lm_head.weight and final RMSNorm is model.language_model.norm.weight.

TorchSpec HFTargetModel default aux layers are [1, n//2-1, n-4] = [1, 39, 76] for 80 layers. Pinned vLLM default is (2, 40, 77) under EagleModelMixin indexing. Putative correspondence only; T3 must prove it.
dataset.chat_template=qwen is not valid for Apertus. Use the Apertus renderer in training/apertus_eagle/.
